title: 1 Peter Chapter 3 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 Peter chapter 3 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 Peter Chapter 3 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 Peter Chapter 3.

questions.question: In 1 Peter 3, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Wives be in subjection to your own husbands
Husbands dwell with them according to knowledge
Be ye all of one mind
questions.correctAnswer: Wives be in subjection to your own husbands
questions.explanation: This command appears first in the text, specifically in 1 Peter 3:1.

questions.question: What should wives be in subjection to?
questions.explanation: The verse states that wives should be in subjection to their own husbands (1 Peter 3:1).

questions.question: How may husbands be won according to 1 Peter 3:1?
questions.explanation: The verse mentions that husbands may be won without the word by the conversation of the wives (1 Peter 3:1).

questions.question: What should be coupled with the chaste conversation of the wives?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:2 states that the chaste conversation should be coupled with fear.

questions.question: What kind of adorning should not be focused on, according to 1 Peter 3:3?
questions.explanation: The verse specifies not to focus on the outward adorning of plaiting the hair, wearing gold, or putting on apparel (1 Peter 3:3).

questions.question: What is described as being in the sight of God of great price?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:4 describes the hidden man of the heart as being of great price in the sight of God.

questions.question: Who adorned themselves in subjection to their husbands in old times?
questions.explanation: The verse states that holy women who trusted in God adorned themselves by being in subjection to their husbands (1 Peter 3:5).

questions.question: Who is mentioned as obeying Abraham?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:6 mentions Sarah as the one who obeyed Abraham.

questions.question: What should husbands give to their wives according to 1 Peter 3:7?
questions.explanation: The verse instructs husbands to give honor unto their wives (1 Peter 3:7).

questions.question: According to 1 Peter 3:7, how should husbands dwell with their wives?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:7 states that husbands should dwell with their wives according to knowledge.

questions.question: What should all brethren have according to 1 Peter 3:8?
questions.explanation: The verse instructs that all should have compassion one of another (1 Peter 3:8).

questions.question: True or False: Wives are encouraged to be in subjection to their husbands.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:1 clearly states that wives should be in subjection to their own husbands.

questions.question: True or False: Husbands should honor their wives as unto the weaker vessel.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:7 mentions that husbands should give honor unto their wives as unto the weaker vessel.

questions.question: True or False: Sarah was disobedient to Abraham.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:6 states that Sarah obeyed Abraham, not the opposite.

questions.question: True or False: All brethren are called to act with hostility towards one another.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:8 calls for compassion among brethren, not hostility.

medium.title: 1 Peter Chapter 3 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 Peter Chapter 3 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What should you refrain from if you want to love life and see good days?
questions.explanation: This is correct because 1 Peter 3:10 states that to love life and see good days, one must refrain his tongue from evil and his lips that they speak no guile.

questions.question: What does 1 Peter 3:12 promise will happen if someone does good?
options: God will not hear their prayers
The Lord's eyes are upon them
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord's eyes are upon them
questions.explanation: This is correct because 1 Peter 3:12 explains that the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, indicating His blessing and attention towards them.

questions.question: What should one do when suffering for righteousness' sake, according to 1 Peter 3:14?
questions.explanation: This is correct because 1 Peter 3:14 states that if you suffer for righteousness' sake, you should be happy.

questions.question: What does 1 Peter 3:11 advise one to seek?
questions.explanation: This is correct as 1 Peter 3:11 encourages believers to seek peace and ensue it.

questions.question: How should you respond to those who speak evil of you, according to 1 Peter 3:16?
questions.explanation: This is correct because 1 Peter 3:16 emphasizes that one should have a good conscience even when falsely accused.

questions.question: What is required when sanctifying the Lord God in your hearts, as stated in 1 Peter 3:15?
options: Be ready to give an answer
questions.correctAnswer: Be ready to give an answer
questions.explanation: This is correct as 1 Peter 3:15 instructs believers to always be prepared to give an answer for their hope.

questions.question: What is the outcome for those who do evil, according to 1 Peter 3:12?
options: The Lord's face is against them
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord's face is against them
questions.explanation: This is correct because 1 Peter 3:12 clearly states that the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.

questions.question: What does 1 Peter 3:13 suggest about being followers of good?
questions.explanation: This is correct as 1 Peter 3:13 implies that no one will harm you if you are a follower of good.

questions.question: In 1 Peter 3:1, who are wives instructed to be in subjection to?
questions.explanation: This is correct because 1 Peter 3:1 specifically instructs wives to be in subjection to their own husbands.

questions.question: According to 1 Peter 3:6, how did Sarah demonstrate her obedience?
questions.explanation: This is correct as 1 Peter 3:6 mentions that Sarah obeyed Abraham by calling him lord.

questions.question: What does 1 Peter 3:8 encourage all believers to have?
questions.explanation: This is correct as 1 Peter 3:8 emphasizes the importance of compassion and unity among believers.

questions.question: What quality does 1 Peter 3:4 say is of great price in God's sight?
questions.explanation: This is correct because 1 Peter 3:4 highlights that the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit is precious in God's eyes.

questions.question: Is it true that 1 Peter 3:15 encourages believers to be prepared to defend their faith?
questions.explanation: This is true as 1 Peter 3:15 instructs believers to be ready to give an answer for their hope.

questions.question: Is it true that 1 Peter 3:10 teaches that speaking guile is acceptable if done in moderation?
questions.explanation: This is false as 1 Peter 3:10 clearly states to refrain from speaking guile altogether.

questions.question: Is it true that 1 Peter 3:12 assures that the Lord will always hear the prayers of the righteous?
questions.explanation: This is false because 1 Peter 3:12 states the Lord's ears are open to the prayers of the righteous, but implies that His face is against those who do evil.

hard.title: 1 Peter Chapter 3 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 Peter Chapter 3.

questions.question: According to 1 Peter 3:17, what is considered better if it is the will of God?
options: To suffer for well doing than for evil doing
To suffer for evil doing rather than well doing
questions.correctAnswer: To suffer for well doing than for evil doing
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:17 clearly states it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

questions.question: In 1 Peter 3:18, for what purpose did Christ suffer once for sins?
options: That he might bring us to God
That he might establish the law
That he might gain earthly power
questions.correctAnswer: That he might bring us to God
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:18 explains that Christ suffered once for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God.

questions.question: Who did Christ preach to according to 1 Peter 3:19?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:19 states that Christ went and preached unto the spirits in prison.

questions.question: In 1 Peter 3:20, how many souls were saved by water during the days of Noah?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:20 specifies that eight souls were saved by water in the days of Noah.

questions.question: According to 1 Peter 3:21, what does baptism now save us by?
options: The putting away of the filth of the flesh
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:21 states baptism saves us by the resurrection of Jesus Christ, not by the putting away of the filth of the flesh.

questions.question: Where is Christ now, according to 1 Peter 3:22?
options: On the right hand of God
questions.correctAnswer: On the right hand of God
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:22 declares that Christ is gone into heaven and is on the right hand of God.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'quickened' (ζῳοποιηθεὶς) in 1 Peter 3:18 mean?
questions.explanation: The Greek word 'quickened' (ζῳοποιηθεὶς) in 1 Peter 3:18 means 'made alive' or 'given life,' referring to Christ being made alive by the Spirit.

questions.question: Which literary device is prominently used in 1 Peter 3:20-21 with the comparison of the flood and baptism?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:20-21 uses typology, where the flood and Noah’s ark prefigure baptism as a means of salvation.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage connects to the theme of 1 Peter 3:20 about disobedient spirits and Noah’s ark?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:5-22 describes the wickedness before the flood and God's command to Noah to build the ark, connecting to 1 Peter 3:20's mention of disobedient spirits and the ark.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the theme of suffering for righteousness found in 1 Peter 3:17?
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:10-12 speaks of being persecuted for righteousness and the blessing that follows, echoing the theme of suffering for well doing in 1 Peter 3:17.

questions.question: What comes immediately before the instruction in 1 Peter 3:17 about suffering for well doing?
options: Having a good conscience so that those who speak evil may be ashamed
A call to sanctify the Lord God in your hearts
An exhortation to be ready to give an answer for hope
Instructions for wives to be in subjection to their husbands
questions.correctAnswer: Having a good conscience so that those who speak evil may be ashamed
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:16 precedes 3:17, emphasizing having a good conscience so that those who speak evil may be ashamed, setting the context for suffering for well doing.

questions.question: What is the significance of 'the answer of a good conscience toward God' in 1 Peter 3:21?
options: It emphasizes an inward spiritual reality rather than external ritual
It refers to the physical cleansing by water
It means strict adherence to the law
It denotes a public confession of faith
questions.correctAnswer: It emphasizes an inward spiritual reality rather than external ritual
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:21 explains baptism saves not by physical washing but by the answer of a good conscience toward God, highlighting the spiritual significance over ritual.

questions.question: How does 1 Peter 3:7 describe the husband’s role in relation to the wife?
options: Dwell with her according to knowledge, giving honor as the weaker vessel
questions.correctAnswer: Dwell with her according to knowledge, giving honor as the weaker vessel
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:7 instructs husbands to dwell with their wives according to knowledge and give honor to the wife as the weaker vessel.

questions.question: What parallelism is evident between 1 Peter 3:17 and 1 Peter 3:14?
options: Both verses encourage rejoicing in suffering for righteousness
Both verses focus on physical health
questions.correctAnswer: Both verses encourage rejoicing in suffering for righteousness
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:14 and 3:17 both encourage believers to be happy or consider it better when they suffer for righteousness' sake, demonstrating parallel encouragement in suffering.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Peter 3:22, angels and authorities are subject to Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:22 states that angels and authorities and powers are made subject unto Christ.

theological.title: 1 Peter Chapter 3 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 Peter Chapter 3 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does 1 Peter 3:4 teach about sanctification?
options: Sanctification involves the hidden inner self, a meek and quiet spirit valued by God
Sanctification is primarily about external religious observances
Sanctification requires elaborate outward adornment to reflect holiness
Sanctification is a one-time event without ongoing growth
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctification involves the hidden inner self, a meek and quiet spirit valued by God
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:4 emphasizes the 'hidden man of the heart' and the 'ornament of a meek and quiet spirit' which is 'in the sight of God of great price,' highlighting inner sanctification rather than outward appearance.

questions.question: What doctrine does 1 Peter 3:21 teach about salvation?
options: Salvation through baptism is not about external cleansing but the answer of a good conscience toward God
Salvation is solely by water without any spiritual significance
Salvation requires multiple sacraments beyond baptism
questions.correctAnswer: Salvation through baptism is not about external cleansing but the answer of a good conscience toward God
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:21 explains that baptism 'doth also now save us' not by 'putting away of the filth of the flesh' but through 'the answer of a good conscience toward God,' indicating a spiritual reality rather than mere external ritual.

questions.question: What doctrine does 1 Peter 3:18 teach about the atonement?
options: Christ suffered once for sins, the just for the unjust, to bring us to God
Christ suffered multiple times for sins to appease God
Christ's suffering was only a moral example, not substitutionary
Christ's suffering was limited to physical death without spiritual significance
questions.correctAnswer: Christ suffered once for sins, the just for the unjust, to bring us to God
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:18 states that 'Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God,' affirming substitutionary atonement and the unique sufficiency of Christ's one-time sacrifice.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does 1 Peter 3:12 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:12 says 'For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers,' revealing God's omniscience in that He sees and hears all.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does 1 Peter 3:20 particularly highlight?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:20 speaks of God's longsuffering waiting during Noah's days before judgment, showing His patience and mercy toward disobedient humanity.

questions.question: How does 1 Peter 3:7 prepare for the New Testament teaching on mutual respect in marriage?
options: By teaching husbands to honor their wives as weaker vessels and joint heirs of grace
By instructing wives to submit without any reciprocal responsibility
By emphasizing only the husband's authority without regard for the wife
By promoting separation between husband and wife for spiritual purity
questions.correctAnswer: By teaching husbands to honor their wives as weaker vessels and joint heirs of grace
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:7 commands husbands to 'dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel,' which anticipates mutual respect and spiritual equality in marriage.

questions.question: How does 1 Peter 3:18-19 connect to Old Testament themes of Christ's victory over spiritual powers?
options: Christ preaching to spirits in prison echoes the defeat of evil powers in captivity
It denies any interaction with spiritual beings
It focuses solely on earthly ministry without spiritual implications
questions.correctAnswer: Christ preaching to spirits in prison echoes the defeat of evil powers in captivity
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:18-19 shows Christ's triumph by proclaiming to imprisoned spirits, alluding to His victory over demonic forces and fulfilling Old Testament motifs of God's sovereign reign over spiritual realms.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses 1 Peter 3:8 and 1 Peter 3:9 teach about Christian ethics?
options: Christians must cultivate unity and respond to evil with blessing
Christians are permitted to return evil for evil to maintain justice
Christian ethics prioritize personal rights over love
Christians should avoid all social interaction to prevent conflict
questions.correctAnswer: Christians must cultivate unity and respond to evil with blessing
questions.explanation: Verses 3:8 and 3:9 together emphasize unity ('be ye all of one mind') and the refusal to return evil for evil, instead blessing others, reflecting the ethical call to love and harmony.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses 1 Peter 3:15 and 1 Peter 3:16 teach about Christian witness?
options: Believers must sanctify Christ in their hearts and be ready to give a reason for their hope with meekness
Witness is only effective through loud proclamation without gentleness
Christians need not defend their faith to skeptics
Witness depends on manipulating others emotionally rather than good conscience
questions.correctAnswer: Believers must sanctify Christ in their hearts and be ready to give a reason for their hope with meekness
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:15-16 teaches that Christians should 'sanctify the Lord God in your hearts' and be always prepared to explain their hope, doing so with meekness and a good conscience, emphasizing respectful and reasoned apologetics.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses 1 Peter 3:1 and 1 Peter 3:6 teach about the Christian wife’s role?
options: A Christian wife’s submissive conduct can win an unbelieving husband by her godly behavior
A Christian wife should dominate her husband to enforce faith
Wives have no influence on their husband’s spiritual condition
Submission is unnecessary if the husband is unbelieving
questions.correctAnswer: A Christian wife’s submissive conduct can win an unbelieving husband by her godly behavior
questions.explanation: Verses 3:1 and 3:6 show that wives are called to be in subjection so that disobedient husbands may be 'won by the conversation of the wives,' exemplified by Sarah’s obedience to Abraham.

questions.question: Skeptics claim 1 Peter 3:19-20 teaches that Christ preached to fallen angels after death. What does 1 Peter 3:19-20 actually teach?
options: Christ preached to disobedient human spirits from Noah’s time, not fallen angels
Christ descended to hell to evangelize fallen angels
Christ’s spirit was inactive between death and resurrection
The passage refers to a mythological event unrelated to salvation
questions.correctAnswer: Christ preached to disobedient human spirits from Noah’s time, not fallen angels
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:19-20 clarifies that Christ 'preached unto the spirits in prison,' identified as those 'sometime were disobedient' in Noah’s days, indicating human spirits rather than fallen angels.

questions.question: What doctrine does 1 Peter 3:17 teach about the value of suffering?
options: Suffering for doing good is preferable and aligned with God’s will
Suffering for evil deeds is redemptive
Suffering should always be avoided regardless of cause
God punishes all suffering equally without distinction
questions.correctAnswer: Suffering for doing good is preferable and aligned with God’s will
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:17 states it is better 'if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing,' teaching the positive value of suffering in obedience.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does 1 Peter 3:22 specifically demonstrate?
options: Sovereignty over angels, authorities, and powers
questions.correctAnswer: Sovereignty over angels, authorities, and powers
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:22 affirms Christ’s ascension and position 'on the right hand of God,' with 'angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him,' demonstrating divine sovereignty.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do 1 Peter 3:10 and 1 Peter 3:11 teach about the ethical life of the righteous?
options: The righteous control their speech, avoid evil, do good, seek and pursue peace
Righteousness is demonstrated solely through ritual observance
The righteous are exempt from trials and temptations
Ethical living is impossible without political power
questions.correctAnswer: The righteous control their speech, avoid evil, do good, seek and pursue peace
questions.explanation: Verses 3:10-11 stress refraining from evil speech, doing good, and actively seeking peace as hallmarks of the righteous life.

questions.question: How does 1 Peter 3:2 contribute to the biblical understanding of witness and sanctification?
options: A chaste conversation coupled with reverential fear serves as a non-verbal witness to unbelievers
Only verbal preaching is effective for sanctification
External adornment is the primary witness to holiness
Fear here means terror and drives people away from faith
questions.correctAnswer: A chaste conversation coupled with reverential fear serves as a non-verbal witness to unbelievers
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:2 explains that unbelieving husbands 'behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear,' indicating that godly conduct and reverence serve as powerful non-verbal witness.
